description: Støy flyplass is a dataset listed in National Data Catalog of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by open.stavanger.kommune.no. Støysoner for utendørs støy rundt støykilden flyplass, dette er en verste tilfelle kombinasjon av dagens forhold og prognosesituasjonen. Gul sone – Støynivå 52 dB Lden, vurderingssone. Rød sone – Støynivå 62 dB Lden, vurderingssone. Støysonene er utarbeidet i samsvar med T-1442: Retningslinjer for behandling av støy i arealplanlegging. Coverage: NO. Its keywords include Kart, flyplass, Støy, Stavanger. The listing shows 1 download or service links in GEO+JSON. The listing shows 2018-02-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data (NLOD) 2.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-norge-no.
